[image: Medicaid for All: Real Choice, Real Coverage illustration] Medicaid for All: Real Choice, Real Coverage Medicaid for All is opt-in coverage for citizens and legal residents. All medically necessary care is covered, no diagnosis or category required. Premiums are capped by income, free below a set threshold, and priced using Medicare-negotiated rates. Full enrollment within three years, backed by real outreach funding so people know it exists. Funded by drug price negotiation, administrative savings, spending cuts, and House-originated legislation closing corporate and wealth tax loopholes, not by taxing workers, and structured as mandatory spending so it can't lapse through inaction the way ACA subsidies just did. [image: Solving Michigan's Housing Crisis illustration] Solving Michigan's Housing Crisis Housing is a homelessness problem, a shortage problem, and a market-power problem, and this plan answers all three. Lydia will pass a rapid rehousing program through HHS to get Michiganders off the streets fast, funded by capping the Pentagon budget rather than cutting help for people. She will fund zoning reform and homebuyer and builder credits to add housing supply, and close the corporate landlord loopholes and algorithmic rent-fixing driving costs up. Read More
